name: read-back
wording: What a party hands the operator at a gate: where things stand, in plain words rendered from the records, the design state included, with one recommendation, ending with the sign-off it waits on. The architect's story read-back says whether the design serves the operator's intent; the lead's plan read-back says how the story will be built. At a session's start the architect's carries the current design, then what is open, then the stories and tasks in flight, before anything is recorded or changed. One held at a gate or called by the operator ends its holder's turn until the operator answers.
reason: The operator: the design state a session reads was long human prose restating facts across concepts and carrying decisions with their situations; its reader is a model, so the state is the design alone, each concept as its established name and residue, and decisions and their reasons are history.
